saturation.rule: Saturation is recorded per segment as no new code in the last two real interviews. With zero interviews it is false and must not be claimed.

denominatorRule: No rate may be reported where its denominator is zero. With zero coded units every proportion is undefined, not 0% and not 100%.
note: Nothing was coded because no interview record exists. Cohen's kappa is null and its status is NOT_COMPUTED; no agreement value may be invented to satisfy the double-coding target.
